sqlMap.select: SELECT TABLE_NO, DECODE(TABLE_NAME, 'AR', '考勤', 'HR', '人事', 'BN', '奖金', 'IS', '保险', 'PA', '工资', 'SY', '系统', TABLE_NAME) TABLE_NAME, PARENT_TABLE_NO FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(TT.TABLE_NAME, 0, INSTR(TT.TABLE_NAME, '_') - 1) TABLE_NAME, SUBSTR(TT.TABLE_NAME, 0, INSTR(TT.TABLE_NAME, '_') - 1) TABLE_NO, '0' PARENT_TABLE_NO FROM USER_TAB_COMMENTS T, USER_TABLES TT WHERE T.TABLE_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND T.TABLE_NAME = TT.TABLE_NAME AND T.COMMENTS IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT T.COMMENTS TABLE_NAME, TT.TABLE_NAME TABLE_NO, SUBSTR(TT.TABLE_NAME, 0, INSTR(TT.TABLE_NAME, '_') - 1) PARENT_TABLE_NO FROM USER_TAB_COMMENTS T, USER_TABLES TT WHERE T.TABLE_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND T.TABLE_NAME = TT.TABLE_NAME AND T.COMMENTS IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY TABLE_NO
